import pytest
from rpn import rpn_eval

def test_happy_path_multi_operator():
    """Test a multi-operator expression"""
    assert rpn_eval("3 4 + 2 *") == 14.0

def test_addition():
    """Test addition operator"""
    assert rpn_eval("5 3 +") == 8.0

def test_subtraction():
    """Test subtraction operator"""
    assert rpn_eval("10 4 -") == 6.0

def test_multiplication():
    """Test multiplication operator"""
    assert rpn_eval("3 7 *") == 21.0

def test_division():
    """Test division operator"""
    assert rpn_eval("15 3 /") == 5.0

def test_division_by_zero():
    """Test division by zero raises ValueError"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Division by zero"):
        rpn_eval("5 0 /")

def test_unknown_token():
    """Test unknown token raises ValueError"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unknown token"):
        rpn_eval("3 4 + abc")

def test_too_few_operands():
    """Test too few operands raises ValueError"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Not enough operands"):
        rpn_eval("3 +")

def test_empty_expression():
    """Test empty expression raises ValueError"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Empty expression"):
        rpn_eval("")

def test_leftover_operands():
    """Test leftover operands raises ValueError"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid expression"):
        rpn_eval("3 4 5 +")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])
